provenance.how: constructed from the Go struct's json tags at the pinned ref (message_id/body/body_hash always; conversation_name/sender_label/sender_kind/attachments/attachments_hash/thread_follower/conversation_kind omitempty), and cross-checked against the connector's own reader (_card_metadata) in tests/unit/team_bridge/test_body_response_contract.py; not captured from a running server, because #255's body-response fields are landing in the same window as this file
provenance.thread_follower_note: a POINTER on the wire: false is emitted (this wake is not a followed-thread reply), nil omits the key entirely, and the server computes it for the CALLING endpoint only - a root row carries no key at all
provenance.conversation_kind_note: set on every conversation row (dm|group|channel), omitted on pair rows
provenance.thread_root_note: the thread root is NOT part of this response: it rides the feed ref (message_available ids.thread_root_id) and the card binds the two together

payload_optional.thread_follower: bool (pointer: false emitted, absent on a root)

unfollowed_thread_reply.body: same thread, recipient never joined it
